item.title: Thorpedo Anna Seeks Redemption in the Fleur De Lis Stakes
item.description: The beloved Thorpedo Anna returns to Churchill Downs this Saturday to seek redemption for her last-place finish in the La Troienne Stakes (G1). The 2024 Horse of the Year will take on a field of four other fillies and mares in the Fleur De Lis Stakes (G2).

item.description: After a rollercoaster start to her career, PONDERING has turned into a serious racehorse. The Brendan Walsh trainee seeks her third stakes win this Saturday in the Holiday Inaugural at Turfway Park.Pondering is a half-sister to Think Big, who captured three graded stakes this year. item.title: Cy Fair: Boy-Beating Breeders
item.description: Cy Fair emerged as a rising turf star in 2025, earning Breeders’ Cup glory while bringing hope and joy to her Texas connections after devastating floods.

item.title: White Abarrio Set for Pegasus World Cup Redemption After Breeders’ Cup Drama
item.description: Just moments before chasing a second Breeders’ Cup trophy, the striking light grey White Abarrio was scratched at the starting gate. He returns this Saturday in search of redemption.
